title: quick light mediterranean rice bowl
description: this dish features turmeric powder, mirepoix-base, and is macrobiotic-friendly. it is sweet, dense, and light, making it perfect for a quick lunch or dinner.
instructions: heat 1 tbsp of olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
add the chopped onions and cook until they are translucent, about 5 minutes.
add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
add the chopped carrots and celery and cook for 5 minutes, until they start to soften.
add the cooked quinoa to the skillet and stir to combine with the vegetables.
sprinkle the turmeric powder over the top and stir to combine.
season with salt and black pepper to taste.
squeeze the lemon juice over the top and stir to combine.
garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve hot.
serve immediately, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
this dish is best served immediately, as the quinoa will continue to cook and become mushy if it sits for too long.
